title: Unit Event — Lead With Courage and Kindness — Episode5 Out Of Sync

meta.Event Outline: Honami considers Mr. Shindo's question of what kind of music she aspires to, but finds herself feeling restless as she's unable to find an answer. Meanwhile, Mr. Shindo discusses Leo/need with the president of Solis Records.

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! A big music festival?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll get suggested for it depending on how our performance goes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which means you'll need to practice really hard for it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, that's the plan...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, the festival is important, but I'd like for us to put on the best performance we can for Mr. Shindo and Mr. Ota too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too...
As pros, we need to be ready to do that for anyone on demand.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, you should take this energy and do your best during practice today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We will!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They certainly sound motivated.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Honami in particular...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Her mind seems clearer now that she knows what she wants to do for this band. She's focusing much better as a result.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and becoming the leader must also have something to do with that. Something about the way she's playing is more compelling than ever before.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They're putting on a compelling performance. I can feel their confidence resonating through each note...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (At the same time, something feels off...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This sound...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Stop.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We fell out of sync again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're achieving the same sort of momentum as before, but we're also all over the place for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, something didn't feel right to me either...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But why...?
I'm being super careful not to rush ahead...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't blame one person, since we've had trouble getting on the same page all the time lately.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I thought I was the one causing all this...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I mean, not having an answer to that question was distracting me. I was having trouble focusing and keeping up with the others because of it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(But I have my answer now.
I'm having a much easier time focusing.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't get it! How do we keep ending up all over the place?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I don't know, but it's almost as if...
We're all pointed in different directions or something.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Different directions...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's just a guess, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think this has something to do with you all hashing out what your aspirations are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's because they hashed that out...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each of you now knows what you wish to do in terms of your music. You feel more confident as a result.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, you're also trying to accomplish slightly different goals from one another.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if you're all subconsciously doing what you can to make your own aspirations a reality?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
That would certainly explain why they can't stay in sync.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
KAITO may be right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You wish to move people's hearts, Shiho, which results in you producing this powerful energy. Meanwhile, Saki exudes kindness because she wants to cheer everybody up...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In other words, because you're all prioritizing different things, you're struggling to stay on the same page.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, so... Them deciding what they want their music to be about was a bad thing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, I doubt that's the case.
They're clearly playing a lot better and really letting their feelings flow through each note.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How they each feel as individuals is important, but they need to be a single unit when performing together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! That sounds really hard...!
How are they supposed to do that?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You may want to discuss what you should be feeling as you play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What we should be feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes.
For instance, the intro for this song...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It screams, “Cheering everyone up is what's most important right now, so let's put on a performance which does that.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, let's give that a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know getting on the same page so to speak isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm sure we're going to sound even better if we figure out how to do that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, let's do our best...!
For Mr. Ota, Mr. Shindo and everyone who we want to feel moved by our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...!
